codeReview.summary: The implementation is solid and fully covers the feature description. Three new files were created: CollapsibleCard.tsx (92 lines), SkinnyColumnBar.tsx (72 lines), and a major expansion of PromotionPage.tsx (+408 lines). All 8 required card sections render with correct titles. Collapsible cards use shadcn Collapsible with status dots and chevron animations. Skinny bar navigation works for collapsed columns. Responsive layout switches between three-column (>=1024px) and single-column (<1024px). Profile redirect to /start is implemented. 27 unit tests cover all three components. TypeScript compiles cleanly, ESLint passes, and all tests pass.

issues.description: getCardHasContent('basicDetailsCard') checks promotionEntries, specialHours, howToShopItems, and importantNotesItems — but those fields belong to other cards (Discount Entries, Special Hours, How to Shop, Important Notes). The Basic Details card should check its own fields (promoDateRange, promoTitle, promoYear). Currently, filling ANY card's data will also mark Basic Details as 'filled', which is semantically incorrect. The status dots for other cards are correct since they check only their own fields.

Several tests produce 'update inside a test was not wrapped in act(...)' warnings from React. These are caused by async state updates from the Zustand store's loadFromIndexedDB() and useEffect callbacks. Tests pass but the warnings indicate potential race conditions in test reliability. Wrapping the assertions in waitFor() or using act() would eliminate these warnings.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used Python Playwright script instead of agent-browser for visual verification because agent-browser couldn't navigate to React SPA routes correctly (was navigating to old vanilla HTML routes). This is a recurring pattern — the skill should document that agent-browser may need SPA route handling (e.g., direct URL navigation instead of link clicking) for React Router apps.

The architecture.md lists only CollapsibleCard and SkinnyColumnBar under Promotion Components, but the current codebase has 8 additional promotion components (BasicDetailsEditor, DiscountEntriesEditor, FormattableItemEditor, SpecialHoursEditor, PDFAttachments, SubjectLineGenerator, BulkEmailTools). These were added by subsequent features but architecture.md was not updated to reflect them.

summary: Feature passes review. The three-column layout, collapsible card system, status dots, skinny bar navigation, responsive design, and profile redirect are all correctly implemented with good code quality. Two non-blocking issues noted: (1) basicDetailsCard status dot incorrectly checks fields from other cards, and (2) React act() warnings in tests. Both are minor and don't affect functionality.
